English: Peddlers Blanket
A simple blanket spread upon the earth, where itinerant traders begin to hawk their wares to the clan. The first seeds of commerce take root.
Open Market Stand
A collection of crude wooden stands and awnings, giving structure to the bustling nomad market and attracting more traders to the camp.
Barter Table
Rough-hewn tables with awnings, where haggling and barter replace crude trade. A step toward permanent commerce in the heart of the steppe.
Artisan Stall
Dedicated stalls for skilled artisans and craftsmen, lending prestige and permanence to the nomadic market.
Merchant Tent
Large canvas tents house established merchants, storing rare wares and fostering trade networks that reach distant clans.
Guild Market Tent
A grand tented pavilion where guilds oversee trade, regulate quality, and safeguard commerce among the nomadic clans.
Traders’ Square
The heart of the market transformed into a bustling square, with semi-permanent stalls and a fixed layout for traders and buyers alike.
Guild Exchange
A thriving hub where merchants and guilds set trade agreements, currency exchanges, and ensure fair dealings across the steppe.
Master Merchant Pavilion
An imposing tented complex reserved for master merchants and guild leaders, centralizing trade, arbitration, and clan commerce.
Grand Guild Market
A permanent, renowned market complex with stone foundations and timber pavilions, drawing merchants from all corners of the world and making the clan a center of nomadic commerce.
